images.scene: A lone business owner in shirt, suspenders and loosened tie sitting at a wooden table, leaning forward with his forearms on the table, staring down intently at a large old worn wooden board game with a winding path of plain carved squares and a few small wooden pawns, dramatic low side light, 1950s. The board squares are completely plain with no letters or numbers. The man, the table and the board fill the lower half of the frame, his chest and the table edge bleeding off the bottom edge.
